LESSON: TAWBAH (REPENTANCE)

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: GRADE
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.2: Tawbah (Repentance)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Tawbah (Repentance), part of Devotional Acts in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: Why should a Muslim seek repentance from Allah (S.W.T.)? 2. How should Muslims seek repentance from Allah (S.W.T.)?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on the conditions for tawbah in groups and present them on a chart,

2. discuss the significance of tawbah (Q25:70, Q39:53) in pairs/groups and make class presentation,

3. dramatize ways of seeking forgiveness from Allah (S.W.T.), learners with blindness can be given physical support as they dramatis,

4. search for Hadith on tawbah online or from available reference materials individually/ in pairs/groups and draw lessons from them. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on the conditions for tawbah in groups and present them on a chart,
2. discuss the significance of tawbah (Q25:70, Q39:53) in pairs/groups and make class presentation,
3. dramatize ways of seeking forgiveness from Allah (S.W.T.), learners with blindness can be given physical support as they dramatis,
4. search for Hadith on tawbah online or from available reference materials individually/ in pairs/groups and draw lessons from them. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Tawbah (Repentance) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy enhanced as learners search for the Hadith on Tawbah online

• Communication and collaboration enhanced as learners discuss the significance of tawbah (Q25:70, Q39:53) and make class
